title: Malavedan language - Wikipedia
text: Malavedan (Malai Vedan, IPA: [mɐlɐʋeːɖɐn]) is a Dravidian language of Kerala and Tamil Nadu that is closely related to Malayalam. Malavedan speakers are one of the tribal groups in Kerala.

title: Malavedan language — Grokipedia
text: The Malavedan language, designated by the ISO 639-3 code mjr, is the standard name for this Dravidian tongue spoken primarily by tribal communities in southern India.
